title: Who Belongs Here?
instruction: Place each animal where its needs are met. You may build one link across the road.
intro: Four species, six possible homes. Read each animal's needs on its card — and remember the corridor rule your team chose.

objectives.label: Great hornbill: nest tree with a fig nearby
Malabar gliding frog: forest beside the stream
Nilgiri tahr: grassland linked to cliffs

challenge.text: Get every animal right on the first check.
